full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 33
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
2083 Ashar 24, Thursday
11:00 AM
Presentation of Annual Report
1. On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will present:
(a) "Annual Report of the Attorney General 2081/082".
(b) "Annual Report of the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority 2081/082".
2. On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam will:
(a) Seek permission to present the "National Service Corps Bill, 2083".
(b) Present the "National Service Corps Bill, 2083".
(c) Present the proposal to "Consider the Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, 2083".

Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
